The vault is an OutLayer agent wallet (testnet-api.outlayer.ai): the wraps, Ref swaps, USDT.e payouts, fee and leftover returns were signed by that wallet through OutLayer, under a wallet policy the worker wrote per mandate from the DAO-approved terms. Also real: NEAR AI TEE parsing + signed completions + attestation; Sputnik DAO votes and funding Transfers; mandate contract state and report anchoring; real 403 policy_denied from OutLayer. NOT PROVEN (mainnet-only): confidential swaps, Intents cross-chain payouts. Testnet has no hidden execution: trades are public testnet transactions. Testnet token values are worthless play money; Ref testnet pools are thin.

report.summary: Mandate 23 sold 0.4 wNEAR across 5 on-chain fills for 1.6146 USDT in proceeds at an average price of 4.0365 USDT per NEAR (worst fill 3.7218), paying a fee of 0.008073 USDT. Execution came in 2,320 bps (-23.2%) below the benchmark TWAP of 5.2557, but the worst fill stayed above the 2 USDT floor price, the floor was respected, and no violations were recorded. Successful payouts of 0.8033 USDT to alice and 0.3213 USDT to bob totaled 1.1246 USDT, with a leftover of 0.48196 USDT returned to quietdao-83872.sputnikv2.testnet.
